an4.42:1.1: Cattār' imāni bhikkhave pañhavyākaraṇāni. Katamāni cattāri? Atthi bhikkhave pañho ekaṃsavyākaraṇīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho paṭipucchā-vyākaraṇīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho ṭhapanīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho vibhajjavyākaraṇīyo. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri pañhavyākaraṇānīti.
an4.42:2.1: Ekaṃsa-vacanaṃ ekaṃ vibhajja-vacanaṃ paraṃ Tatiyaṃ paṭipuccheyya catuttham pana ṭhāpaye
an4.42:3.1: Yo ca tesaṃ tattha tattha jānāti anudhammataṃ Catu pañhassa kusalo āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhaṃ
an4.42:4.1: Durāsado duppasaho gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo Atho atthe anatthe ca ubhayassa hoti kovido
an4.42:5.1: Anatthaṃ parivajjeti atthaṃ gaṇhāti paṇḍito Atthābhisamayā dhūro paṇḍito ti pavuccatīti.
